title: Tip from Angela - How to Work as a Freelancer
summary: Short career tip on starting freelance web development: accumulate a portfolio and client references on low-paying marketplaces first, then move to higher-paying platforms.

concepts.heading: Starting out as a freelancer
points: Early obstacle: landing good contracts is hard without references or sample work, so the first goal is a portfolio plus clients who can vouch for you.
Begin on low-budget marketplaces such as Fiverr to practise dealing with real clients: working out what they need, communicating clearly, and delivering what they asked for.
Low pay at this stage is acceptable because the value is real projects, reviews and experience.
As skills and portfolio grow, move to platforms such as Upwork, Guru or Freelancer and charge more.
Rough timeline: about a year of steady small jobs should yield enough finished projects and testimonials to aim for premium clients.

pitfalls: Pitching for top-paying gigs with no portfolio or references.
